text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day. Many Umamusume are merrily walking around carrying chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you so late. But, I made you some chocolates…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: I didn't think you were interested in this kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well… I wanted to show my appreciation for all you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sure what to make at first, which is why I'm here so late. I'm really sorry.
choice_data_list: No, no. I really appreciate it. Thank you.
No, no. I really appreciate it. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take the box of chocolates she's made.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… About the contents…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: These aren't your typical Valentine's Day chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're always so busy, so… I thought I should make some with nutritional value.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So, you see, I made them using vegetables that help fight off fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the box to find it filled with veggie chips coated with chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You think so? Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I caught some of this Valentine's special on the common-room TV as I left the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The chocolates they were showcasing were really different from mine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It made me think I should've tried something… cuter.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I'm not really good at these kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spend a memorable Valentine's Day with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what kind of food you like…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So I actually went with strawberry mochi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the box to see two snow-white mochi, carefully molded over the strawberry and sweet bean paste within.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Strawberry mochi is my number-one favorite sweet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So I thought I might be able to make them especially good…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering she's made two, I'd like to enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh no… That wasn't my intention!
choice_data_list: It's all right. Let's eat them together!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well… If you insist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We both stuff our mouths with the sweets. The balance of sour strawberry and sweet bean paste is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Mmm… So good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spend a very heartwarming Valentine's Day with Silence Suzuka.
